weightAndConceptReview.ucr-1: Communication/rhetoric, organisational and empirical methods provide a substantive response. Business/data/media courses have specific complementary functions. Gaps in intercultural and specialist communication research remain explicit.
weightAndConceptReview.ucr-2: Sustained rhetoric/media and civil-society/environmental study implements the documented social-impact direction. Health context is one course; no specialist health-communication sequence is claimed.
weightAndConceptReview.ucr-3: Rhetoric/text/media, psycholinguistics and AI ethics ground a human/digital response. Technical methods form a substantial supporting sequence; autonomous planning/vision are not presented as substitutes for conversation or chatbot evaluation.

stopping: Three distinct evidenced concepts retained. Multilingual/intercultural business direction is documented but cannot become a fourth. Numeric distinctness is not the reason for including them.
